questions.question_text: What does the Writing Test measure?
options: Your ability to write complex poetry.
Writing skills taught in high school English and entry-level college courses.
Your ability to summarize long research papers.
questions.explanation: The test measures writing skills taught in high school English classes and in entry-level college composition courses.

questions.question_text: How many prompts are provided in the Writing Test?
questions.explanation: The Writing Test consists of one single prompt to be addressed in 40 minutes.

questions.question_text: How long is the Writing Test?
questions.explanation: The Writing Test is 40 minutes long.

questions.question_text: How long is the Writing Test section?
questions.explanation: The Writing Test provides 40 minutes to write the essay.

questions.question_text: Is the Writing Test a required section of the ACT?
options: No, it is an optional add-on
Only for students with specific accommodations
questions.explanation: The Writing section is optional and does not affect the Composite score.

questions.question_text: What should a student bring to the Writing Test?
options: No extra materials, just their standard testing items
questions.explanation: The writing section does not require external tools beyond the standard testing environment.
